Prototype thruster pack.name: Prototype thruster pack
Prototype thruster pack.description: A compact backpack thruster from U.A.'s Development Studio, with two nozzles, a fuel cell and a trigger strapped to the wearer's palm. It turns a fall into a controlled drop and a jump into a short powered leap, and now and then it sputters out or overheats at the worst moment. [ Support Gear | Prototype, not for sale ]
